description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 4, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: openclaw/openclaw is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: openclaw/openclaw leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: openclaw/openclaw — 123 commits today, 441.3 below its current daily pace, with 152 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
NousResearch/hermes-agent — 10 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
QwenLM/qwen-code — No same-day commit after 198 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: OpenWork removes the read-only ceiling on saved Workflows
dailyInsight.insight: OpenWork has merged support for connection tools and writes in live and unattended Workflows. A procedure that worked interactively can now reach those capabilities through the saved execution path too.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The October 3 UTC change removes the Den-only, read-only filter from live authoring and Workflow execution. Required capabilities must still be present, and tool dispatch uses the runner's authority. An App-bound live Workflow is labelled read-only only when all its declared capabilities are OpenWork reads.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: A saved procedure can now include external work, such as a connected service operation, instead of failing because that tool disappears from the live tool tree. App authors also need to account for the resulting permission prompt.

actions.label: Check a containing build with a disposable connection
actions.instruction: Watch for a build containing this change, then test one saved connection-tool call in a disposable workspace. Compare interactive, live and Automation execution under the intended runner account, and check the App's permission prompt before using a write on real records.
actions.effort: One version check and a bounded three-mode comparison

receipts.title: Workflows reach connection tools and writes
receipts.supports: Removes the restricted tool tree, normalizes recorded capability names, and changes the App read-only annotation to depend on declared capabilities.

receipts.title: Pinned execution regression definitions
receipts.supports: Defines successful write and external-tool cases in explicit, live and Automation modes while retaining missing-capability rejection.

confidence.basis: The inspected implementation and test definitions agree on the broader execution contract. The tests and a live connected-service run were not executed here.

dailyInsight.limitation: Merged source does not establish deployment availability, exactly-once external writes, or successful unattended operation against a real service.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing build that still filters a correctly authorized declared connection tool out of live execution would contradict this reading.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing build and a public integration run that includes a write, a revoked connection and a retried Automation.
